notes: Identity independently confirmed in canonical title page: Maureen A. Craig and Jennifer A. Richeson; On the Precipice of a “Majority-Minority” America: Perceived Status Threat From the Racial Demographic Shift Affects White Americans’ Political Ideology; Psychological Science 2014, 25(6), 1189–1197; DOI 10.1177/0956797614527113. Full primary research article is included after a primary 2015 corrigendum (DOI 10.1177/0956797615578857), which says Studies 3a and 3b are unaffected. No PDF supplied. Original p. 5 (1193) contains methods; relevant results are p. 1194. Candidate A: overall-policy contrast F(1, 161) = 6.94, p = .009, partial eta squared .04. Candidate B: mixed-design contrast across policy types F(1, 161) = 7.12, p = .008, partial eta squared .04. Both fit the supplied neutral description, so equal effect-size values do not resolve target correspondence. Printed metric is partial eta squared; no conversion performed. Final three-condition model sample explicitly 170, with mutually exclusive groups 62 + 59 + 49 = 170 participants. Contrasted arms total 62 + 49 = 111 participants, but this is not asserted as fitted-model N. All counts remain candidates for parent field-scope review because the critical test is unresolved. No N inferred from df. Canonical column extraction places the continuation containing 49 before the final-sample sentence beginning; quote fragments retain canonical order. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders.
